caveat: This CDM extract has no B-plane covariance. matched_sigma_m is solved so the isotropic integral equals catalog Pc. Monte Carlo agreement with catalog Pc checks the sampler. Surrogate agreement with Monte Carlo is agreement with that catalog label, up to sampling noise. screening_1km_pc uses the catalog exclusion radii and a 1 km default sigma and is not fit to catalog Pc.
